Hazel & Frame Photography — Freelance Photographer Portfolio

Natural-light portraits, weddings, and editorial stories captured across the Blue Ridge Mountains and beyond. Based in Asheville, North Carolina — available for travel.

Book a Session

About the Photographer

I'm Hazel Monroe, a freelance photographer with ten years of experience telling honest, light-filled stories through portraiture. My work favors soft natural light, candid emotion, and the quiet in-between moments most photographers rush past.

I studied fine art photography at Appalachian State University and spent several years assisting photojournalists before opening my own studio in 2016. Since then I've photographed over 300 weddings, families, and brands across the Southeast.

My Philosophy

A photograph should feel like a memory, not a performance. I aim to work quietly, letting real moments unfold, so the images you keep are the ones that actually happened.

Gallery

A selection of recent portrait, wedding, and editorial work.

Services & Packages

Every package includes a pre-session consultation, professionally edited high-resolution images, and an online gallery for sharing and downloads.

Portrait Session

$275

1 hour on location, 25 edited images, one outfit change. Ideal for individuals, couples, or small families.

Family Session

$425

1.5 hours on location, 45 edited images, up to six people, multiple setting options.

Wedding Collection

From $2,400

8 hours of coverage, second shooter available, 500+ edited images, engagement session included.

Client Testimonials

“Hazel made our wedding day feel effortless. The photos are the most beautiful, honest images we could have hoped for.”

— Maria & Daniel Ortiz

“Our family session was so relaxed, even our toddler was smiling for the camera. We'll treasure these forever.”

— The Alvarez Family

“Professional, warm, and incredibly talented. I recommend Hazel to every bride I know.”

— Priya Chandran

Get in Touch

Have a date in mind or just want to learn more? Send a message below, or reach out directly — I typically respond within one business day.
